reason: I already pay about 20 a month for ChatGPT and it does most of this when I paste things in. 99 € a month, or 708 € locked in for a year, is a lot on my income for something I can't see doing more than what I already have.
objection: Will these 'managers' actually send the emails and answer customers on their own, or will I still be rewriting drafts every evening like I do now with ChatGPT? And 100 credits a month means nothing to me, I don't know if that covers a week or a day.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run one real job for my business end to end on the free plan, like answering my customer emails correctly without me fixing them, and knowing what 100 credits actually buys.
